name: Shell Spawned by Package Manager
description: A shell interpreter was launched as a child of the system package manager. Post-install and update hooks do this legitimately; attackers also use package-manager hooks for execution and persistence. Inspect the process ancestry and the command line before deciding. Lab 3 fixture: real Elastic Defend telemetry, full process tree available in Analyzer.
query: event.type:"start" and process.parent.name:"apt-get" and process.name:("dash" or "sh" or "bash")
author: VGI SOC
false_positives: Package post-install and update-notifier hooks routinely spawn sh.
